spells.name: Riposte
spells.description: Fiora parries all incoming damage, disables, and negative effects for seconds, then stabs. The stab deals magic damage to the first champion hit and Slows Move Speed by % and Attack Speed by % for seconds. If Fiora parries an Immobilizing effect, the stabbed enemy is Stunned rather than Slowed.
